WITH per_account AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS account_avg
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
  GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    frequency,
    account_avg,
    account_avg / AVG(account_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio
  FROM per_account
)
SELECT account_id, frequency, account_avg, ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with types other than PRIJEM and VYDAJ are excluded from the account averages and from the per-frequency averages, as requested. The account-level averages are averaged equally within each frequency.
